newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 73.9 bln marks in tender at 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 73.9 bln marks in tender at 3 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said it allocated securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed three percent rate, the rate which has prevailed since late August.

The central bank accepted bids for 73.9 billion marks of the 16-day funds. A repo pact for 69.7 billion marks also at a fixed three percent rate expires today, Wednesday, so a net 4.2 billion marks is flowing into the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 212.6 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. It accepted 34.75 percent of the bids.
